note: Step budgets, net of the baseline op that builds the same operands (field 'base'; 0 bare loop, 1 the restored player + mobj records and the tic's boxed Env, 12 the records alone). Measured by measure.py on Scarb 2.16.0 over Freedoom E1M1; a run over budget by more than 10 % fails (PLAN.md 3.1 rule 4). 'budget' is the measured figure, so the file guards against regression; 'target' is the task's ask, and ../README.md says, with a profile, why the ones that are missed are missed. 'code_words' is the crate's bytecode contribution, measured as bench/size minus bench/baseline (which calls every lower-crate function doom_player reaches) and guarded the same way; 'code_words_proving' is the same difference under the proving profile (unsafe-panic = true). docs/DECISIONS.md D29 allots 20 000 words to this crate ('code_words_target').
